title: I was loving this GoBottle thermos until I discovered it leaked
text:
I was loving this GoBottle thermos until I discovered it leaked. At first I was super impressed with this thermos because of its features and large 64 ounce (1.89 liter) size.

FEATURES

- The small spout is for pouring but I see no reason one cannot drink from that spout. The lid unscrews partly and flips back.

- When the full black section is unscrewed, it exposes a wide mouth thermos that makes it easy to clean and fill.

- The interior is made with 18/8 stainless steel, so there was no off-putting taste.

- It says it keeps drinks hot for 12 hours. I tested this with almost boiling water and after 12 hours the water was still hot to the touch. After 13 hours it started to become warm.

- I love how the exterior of the GoBottle stayed cool even with boiling water inside.

- Although the instructions do not say this, the full black section can be used as a cup. Just unscrew and turn upside down and pour some of the contents into it. The liquid did not leak out from the cup as long as the tiny lid is screwed on tight. Note that it is difficult to hold the large round base with one arm during the pour.

- It is BPA-free.

- It claims it keeps items cold for 48 hours, although I did not test that because I use this for hot items.

- It comes with a 10-year limited warranty.

WARNINGS

- This should be hand washed with mild soap, although they say the lid is dishwasher safe in the top rack. I hand wash everything even though I have a dishwasher, so this warning does not concern me.

- Do not use bleach.

- Fully dry before storing.

- Do not use in the microwave or freezer.

PROBLEMS

This would have gotten five stars except that it is not airtight and not leakproof. When I turned it upside down, the liquid started seeping out. I then tightened the black top as hard as I could, but I still had a few drops that seeped out of the bottom of the base (that is where the black top meets the body of the bottle). I tried this several times and I feel that since the top is plastic, it will eventually break and the seal will become looser or "stretch." This is the only reason I am rating this 3 stars. As long as one keeps this upright, it is fine, but should the bottle turn on its side or upside down, there will definitely be some seepage.
